pyq_bad.why: wrong topic: physics (centre of mass); no key

patterns: Very few genuine PYQs: only the 'three-tier structure' fact; APPSC 2008 asked MACS Act 1995 and trend in number of societies vs 2001-02.
Expect direct AP facts: APCOB-DCCB-PACS tiers, MACS Act 1995 (no govt share capital), 97th Amendment (Art. 19(1)(c), 43B, Part IXB).
Committee-chairman pairs (Vaidyanathan 2004, Prakash Bakshi 2013) are likely single-fact items.
App MCQs rely heavily on APSES/2026 data figures (branch counts, crores, PACS numbers) - much deeper than any PYQ.
